summary: AngloGold Ashanti filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q3 2026 earnings release for the three and nine months ended 30 September 2026. Results show EBITDA up 12% year-on-year to $1,568m, free cash flow of $722m against $920m a year earlier, net cash of $1,256m and roughly $4.5bn liquidity. The board declared a Q3 interim dividend of $361m, or 71 US cents per share, taking year-to-date dividends to $1,310m (259 cps); full-year production guidance was reaffirmed. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure, not a special situation; watch capex and Nevada project progress.
